environmental: GHG  emission  is  expressed  in  carbon  dioxide  equivalent  (CO2e)  which  accounts  for
the  global  warming  potential  (GWP)  of  methane  (CH4)  and  nitrous  oxide  (N2O),  as
prescribed  by  the  Inter-governmental  Panel  on  Climate  Change  (IPCC).  GWP  is  the
ratio of the warming resulting from the emission of one kilogram of a greenhouse gas
to that of one kilogram emission of CO2 over a fixed period of time (i.e. CH4 and N2O
GWP is 21 times and 310 times the CO2 emission, respectively).
